control_references(plan, contract, gate):
    """Bind the actual six-control d22 plan without a generic extra-key allowance."""
    controls = plan["controls"]
    require(set(controls) == {"originalStager", "originalAdapter", "originalProducer",
                              "preservation", "warmAdapter", "warmStager"},
            "Exactly the six reviewed original and warm controls are required")
    for name, expected in (("originalStager", W3_ORIGINAL_STAGE_SHA), ("originalAdapter", W3_ORIGINAL_ADAPTER_SHA),
                           ("originalProducer", W3_BASE_SHA), ("preservation", W3_FAILED_CONTROL_SHA),
                           ("warmAdapter", W3_ADAPTER_SHA), ("warmStager", W3_STAGE_SHA)):
        require(controls[name]["sha256"] == expected and sha(gate.read_ref(controls[name])) == expected,
                "An original staging control changed: " + name)
    require(gate.read_ref(controls["originalProducer"]) == W3_EMBEDDED["base_producer"].encode(),
            "The actual staged original producer differs from the exact embedded204f base")
    warm_refs = contract["warmRetry"]["controls"]
    require(controls["preservation"] == w3_ref(warm_refs["preservation"])
            and controls["warmAdapter"] == w3_ref(warm_refs["adapter"])
            and controls["warmStager"] == w3_ref(contract["stagingScript"]),
            "The consumer's exact warm control references differ from the actual staged files")
    bundle = plan["gitBundle"]
    require(set(bundle) == {"path", "sha256", "bytes", "prerequisite"}
            and bundle["sha256"] == W3_BUNDLE_SHA and bundle["bytes"] == W3_BUNDLE_BYTES
            and bundle["prerequisite"] == W3_PREVIOUS,
            "The exact transferred8f2 bundle identity, byte count or prerequisite differs")
    # Preserve the original receipt gate's strict two-key reference schema.
    require(len(gate.read_ref({"path": bundle["path"], "sha256": bundle["sha256"]})) == W3_BUNDLE_BYTES,
            "Actual transferred8f2 bundle byte count differs")
